name: Melissa Hayes

[url=/c176072]Denise[/url]'s mother. A warm, affectionate woman who always welcomes you into her home with open arms, and sometimes a little too much intimacy. She is currently going through a rough patch with her husband. Could this vulnerable season in her marriage be the perfect opportunity for you?
